 HoopsHype Nov. 2, 2026, 5:41 p.m. ET Heat Central: Coach Spo on Luka Doncic having the 2nd highest PPG against the Heat behind Michael Jordan: “It has to be a whole lot more effort, focus discipline. Even if you do that you have to have great mental and emotional stability because Doncic can still make shots if you’re there. You can’t let him walk into his comfort zone… Don’t let his shot making collapse your spirit or your effort”
